elements.name: young man seen from behind in centre
old boxy cream-coloured country bus seen from side
low houses with rusty corrugated tin roofs
high bright sun with short shadows

wrong_setting: The man faces a round thatched mud hut instead of a bus, and the background houses have thatched roofs instead of rusty corrugated tin. This reads as a rural village, not a highland town bus stop. The ground is pale beige, not red-brown.
notes: Replace the thatched hut with the side of a cream country bus with its door open and bundles on the roof rack, and give the houses rusty corrugated tin roofs. Make the ground red-brown and shorten the long raking shadow to fit a midday sun.
